brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Israeli special forces attempting to enter Gaza City on Tuesday faced resistance operations that thwarted the raid's objectives and inflicted casualties on the troops. Specialists said the engagement demonstrated the continuing presence of armed resistance groups and their capacity to confront occupation forces in active combat.

The clash occurred as Netanyahu's government and coalition pursue what analysts characterize as a strategy converting the war into campaign messaging for electoral purposes. The encounter revealed that resistance forces maintained operational capability and coordination despite the broader conflict unfolding across Gaza. Experts interviewed by the wire service said the Tuesday operation illustrated the sustained threat posed by organized resistance to Israeli military operations in the territory.
